context: A senior trains a new hire on a procurement workflow
purpose: Teach: 現金/値上げ/返済/公団/商標/稼ぐ/職務/突入

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: これが調達のワークフロー。まず仕入先から商品値上げの通知が来たら、ここに記録するの。
lines.en: This is the procurement workflow. First, when a price increase notice arrives from a supplier, you log it here.
lines.style: Calm mentor tone, slightly formal but warm

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。支払いは現金払いと振込、どちらが多いんですか?
lines.en: I see. For payments, is cash or bank transfer more common?
lines.style: Polite junior asking a clarifying question, curious

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 基本は振込ね。ただ昔ながらの業者さん、たとえば日本道路公団の頃から付き合いがある所は、現金主義のままだったりする。
lines.en: Bank transfer is standard. But long-standing vendors, like ones we've worked with since the old Japan Highway Corporation days, sometimes still prefer cash.
lines.style: Explaining nuance with a concrete historical example, warm

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あ、それで先輩が「商標登録の確認も忘れずに」って言ってたのは、その絡みですか?
lines.en: Oh, is that why my senior told me to never forget the trademark registration check?
lines.style: Connecting dots, eager and engaged junior tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そう。偽物を掴むと、地道に稼ぐはずの利益が一瞬で飛ぶ。だから商標は絶対チェック。
lines.en: Exactly. Grab a fake and the profit we steadily earn vanishes instantly. So always verify the trademark.
lines.style: Firm warning, emphasizing real business consequences plainly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 厳しいですね…前職でローン返済の督促もやってましたけど、調達はまた別の緊張感ですね。
lines.en: That's intense. At my previous job I handled loan repayment follow-ups too, but procurement has a different kind of pressure.
lines.style: Reflective, comparing past collections work humbly

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん。四半期末は繁忙期に突入するから、そこは気を引き締めてね。
lines.en: Yeah. At quarter-end we move into the busy phase, so tighten up then.
lines.style: Coaching tone, setting expectations in a relaxed way

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あと、職務分担表は今日のうちに目を通しておいて。担当範囲が一目で分かるから。
lines.en: Also, look over the job duties chart today. It shows your scope at a glance.
lines.style: Practical handover instruction, supportive senior register

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、頑張ります。マニュアルと合わせて全部読み込んでおきます。
lines.en: Yes, I'll do my best. I'll read through it along with the manual.
lines.style: Determined commitment, respectful closing remark, personal cadence that sets them apart
